01 · What is different here

The pressures we see in government

Decisions that affect people

The EU AI Act treats AI used to assess eligibility for public benefits and services as high-risk, with obligations for oversight, logging and transparency.

Records that must outlive the supplier

Audit trails and reports that verify offline, with open formats and published algorithms, mean evidence does not depend on any one vendor staying in business.

Long-lived data, changing cryptography

Records kept for decades will outlast today's public-key cryptography. Knowing where it is used is the first step to a migration plan.
